name: Mechanics of Fluids
description: Introduction to fluids and the concept of viscosity; Flow visualization; Fluid statics: fluid pressure, forces on solid surfaces, buoyant forces; Reynold Transport Theorem; Lagrangian and Eulerian description of fluid flow; Kinematics of fluid flow: equations for acceleration, continuity equation, irrotational and rotational flow, streamlines, streaklines and pathlines, potential and stream functions, flow net; Physical laws for a control volume including continuity, momentum and energy equations, Euler and Bernoulli’s equations, Navier Stokes equations - laminar flow between parallel plates, Plane Poiseuille flow, Couette flow, Stokes flow; Flow measurement in pipes - mouthpieces, orificemeter, pitot tube, venturimeter; Dimensional analysis and similitude; Boundary layer theory; Drag and lift on immersed bodies; Introduction to pumps and turbines.
